entities.name: T3346 value
entities.description: An information element that carries the T3346 timer value, included by the MME when NAS level mobility management congestion control is active.

entities.name: MME
entities.description: The Mobility Management Entity that includes the T3346 value IE when congestion control is active.

entities.name: NAS level mobility management congestion control active
entities.description: A condition where NAS level mobility management congestion control is active, triggering the MME to include the T3346 value IE.

relations.description: The MME includes the T3346 value IE in messages when congestion control is active.
The condition of NAS level mobility management congestion control being active guards the MME's action of including the T3346 value IE.
